test_suite: STM-02 RLS Negative Tests (Zero Persistent Writes)

tests.name: Tenant A claims -> SELECT OK, INSERT own tenant OK
tests.conclusion: Tenant A caller with matching JWT claims successfully reads and inserts tenant-owned records.

tests.name: Cross-tenant insert with Tenant B claims into Tenant A table (must fail WITH CHECK)

result.message: ERROR: new row violates row-level security policy for table "applications"

tests.conclusion: Cross-tenant insertion rejected live by PostgreSQL RLS WITH CHECK policy.

tests.name: Cross-tenant read with Tenant B claims -> Tenant A rows invisible (0 rows)
tests.conclusion: Tenant B claims return exactly 0 rows when querying Tenant A data under RLS USING policy.

tests.name: No tenant claim in claims JSON -> 0 rows
tests.conclusion: Claims missing tenant_id fail closed and return 0 rows.

tests.name: Completely unset/NULL claims -> 0 rows
tests.conclusion: Null/unset claims fail closed and return 0 rows.
